name: st-intake-brief
what: Write the brief: problem, requester, stakes, constraints, deadline, what success looks like.
jev: CODE: headings ## Problem and ## Success looks like exist

name: st-intake-symptom
what: Capture the symptom in the requester's own words, with when it started and how often it returns.

name: st-intake-stakes
what: Name who loses what if nothing changes, in one number with its source.

name: st-intake-authority
what: Record what the requester may change (authority ceiling). It caps the leverage rank later.

name: st-intake-context-classify
what: Classify the decision context: clear, complicated, complex, chaotic, disorder. Disorder is RED.
jev: JEV choice: context class (rig-s1gate), DEFERRED if down

name: st-intake-done-test
what: Write the falsifiable success test that fails today and will pass when fixed.

name: st-frame-boundary
what: Draw the system boundary: what is inside, outside, and ignored on purpose.

name: st-frame-domain
what: Start from a domain frame (gtm, linkedin, sales, founder, mike-os), never a blank page.

name: st-frame-stocks
what: List the stocks (things that accumulate) with unit and current level.
jev: CODE: every stock has a unit

name: st-frame-flows
what: List inflows and outflows for each stock with rate and source.

name: st-frame-actors
what: Name the actors, their goals and the information each one sees.

name: st-frame-loops
what: Find at least one reinforcing (R) and one balancing (B) loop. Label polarity on every link.

name: st-frame-delays
what: Mark every delay and its length; delays are where oscillation and overshoot come from.

name: st-frame-controller
what: Name the controller, observed state, sampling delay, allowed action and UNKNOWN route.

name: st-diagnose-map
what: Run the symptom against the archetype table and get ranked suspects.

name: st-diagnose-archetype
what: Read the suspect archetype (Kim 2000) and its classic intervention.

name: st-diagnose-fixes-that-fail
what: Test for Fixes that Fail: the quick fix's side effect that returns the problem worse.

name: st-diagnose-shifting-burden
what: Test for Shifting the Burden: symptomatic fix eroding the fundamental capability.

name: st-diagnose-limits-growth
what: Test for Limits to Growth: find the limiting condition before pushing harder.

name: st-diagnose-evidence
what: Prove the suspect's predicted stock is actually moving, with a dated read.

name: st-diagnose-counterintuitive
what: Write the counterintuitive finding: what the obvious push would make worse.

name: st-diagnose-doom-loop
what: Name any doom loop (self-reinforcing failure) in the agent fleet or lane and its breaker.

name: st-leverage-rank
what: Place current interventions on Meadows' 12 points (12 weakest, 1 strongest).

name: st-leverage-choose
what: Choose the highest rank the requester's authority allows.

name: st-leverage-reject
what: Record the one-rank-higher option and why it was rejected.

name: st-leverage-wip-cap
what: Set WIP cap, queue-age signal, drain condition and bottleneck owner before adding capacity.
jev: CODE: more agents rejected until constraint evidenced

name: st-leverage-information
what: Check rank-6 information flows: who would act differently if they saw the stock?

name: st-leverage-rules-goals
what: Check rules (5), self-organization (4) and goals (3) before parameters (12).

name: st-ground-cards
what: Pull tagged Recall cards for the domain.

name: st-ground-search
what: Search the live Recall KB for the mechanism.

name: st-ground-library
what: Read the papers/books/youtube library under studio/knowledge.

name: st-ground-cite
what: Cite as [Card: title](url). Never invent a citation.
jev: CODE: every cite resolves to a card id

name: st-ground-gaps
what: Write ## Gaps: absent evidence is a finding, not a blank.

name: st-ground-theory-spine
what: Verify theory provenance against the theory spine.

name: st-polymath-crosspoll
what: Import a mechanism from another domain with the same structure.

name: st-polymath-mechanisms
what: Pull source-gated transfers from curated mechanisms.

name: st-polymath-score
what: Score transfer fit; GREEN needs >= 0.60.

name: st-polymath-deviate
what: Run /deviate engines on the chosen leverage point for far-from-obvious options.

name: st-polymath-falsify
what: Write the falsifier: the observation that would kill the imported mechanism.

name: st-synth-simulate
what: Run the Euler stock-flow model: baseline vs +volume vs information intervention.

name: st-synth-deliverable
what: Assemble DELIVERABLE.md from every prior artifact; shrink nothing silently.

name: st-synth-causal-map
what: Draw the causal loop diagram (Excalidraw/SVG) with the leverage point marked.

name: st-synth-plan
what: Write the falsifiable plan: one intervention, owner, date, KPI, kill criterion.

name: st-synth-second-order
what: List second-order effects and who they hit, 1 week / 1 quarter / 1 year.

name: st-synth-reversibility
what: Assess reversibility; irreversible steps go to Gate-D.

name: st-verify-run-det
what: Run the deterministic 8-phase path; GREEN only if classified, map hits, rank != 12, knowledge >= 2, polymath >= 0.60.

name: st-verify-red-control
what: Run the planted RED (context disorder) and confirm it fails. A gate never failed is not trusted.

name: st-verify-seal
what: Seal the ProofPacket.

name: st-verify-jev-done
what: Gate the done claim with hosted Jev before calling it done.
jev: JEV: done.claim; DEFERRED if down, never PASS

name: st-verify-jev-everywhere
what: Walk the jev-everywhere ladder for every judgment in the run: CODE, JEV, SYSTEM 2, HUMAN.
jev: JEV: one decision id per typed judgment

name: st-verify-jevharness-domain
what: Wrap the 8 phases as a /jevharness switch domain (typed questions per phase) and replay it.

name: st-verify-cold-review
what: Zero-context (goldfish) review of DELIVERABLE.md; fix what it cannot follow.

name: st-loop-define
what: Turn the plan into a rig-loop: trigger, step, check, stop condition.

name: st-loop-cadence
what: Place it on the operating cadence; heavy work runs 21:00-06:00 MT, staggered.

name: st-loop-no-progress
what: Detect spin: same check tail twice = change strategy, not retry.

name: st-kpi-define
what: Define the KPI: before, target, window, unit, probe command, source.
jev: CODE: probe runs and prints a number

name: st-kpi-probe
what: Run the KPI probe; a missing source prints no_source, never zero.

name: st-kpi-scorecard
what: Post the KPI to the systems-thinking scorecard on the Work Canvas.

name: st-goal-register
what: Register the goal: mission + KPI + done-test, bound to the loop.

name: st-goal-check
what: Run goal check; the exit code is the verdict, never the doer.

name: st-goal-close
what: Close with proof: decision id, ProofPacket, canvas updated, three-line report.

name: st-ops-daily
what: Daily: one causal map or leverage spec for a live RIG bottleneck (systems-thinking employee KPI).

name: st-ops-weekly-retro
what: Weekly: what loops moved, which KPIs moved, which held. Retire zero-output steps.

name: st-ops-refresh-corpus
what: Refresh the Recall card index and pack, then studio doctor.

name: st-ops-publish
what: Commit + push the studio and outputs to mrodgersjs-web/mrodgersjs-web systems-thinking/. Secrets scan first.
